name: pzem-017
description: Peacefair PZEM-017 DC energy meter, RS-485 Modbus RTU. Phase 1 bench meter A. Input registers, function 4. Serial 9600 8N2 (two stop bits — a common wiring mistake is 8N1).
notes: The energy counter has 1 Wh resolution. At 150 Wp a five-minute interval is ~12 Wh, so counter deltas would carry ±8 % quantization and fail the 5 % agreement gate on honest data. Energy is therefore integrated from the 0.1 W power register; the counter is decoded and kept in the raw payload as a cross-check.
